閉鎖人口S+E+I+R=1、β=0.6、σ=0.3、γ=0.2。η=10⁻⁴/5×10⁻⁵に対し(S,E,I,R)(0)=(1−2η,η,η,0)、0≤t≤20。出生・死亡・外部流入はありません。 編集上の補足 These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Assumptions, units and boundaries Use a closed population S+E+I+R=1 with β=0.6, σ=0.3 and γ=0.2. For η=10⁻⁴ or 5×10⁻⁵, start from (1−2η,η,η,0) and evolve to t=20. There are no births, deaths or external inflows. Editorial clarification These fixed-coefficient calculations compare two small initial infection levels. The early linearization is not an exact solution through t=20, and a single dominant mode does not replace the two-mode solution. No epidemic forecast, statistical coverage or arbitrary-population guarantee is claimed. Time, concentrations and populations do not define a spatial dimension. The rates are educational, not disease or experimental predictions. Adopted numerical method Evolve all four physical states with RK4 at 400, 800 and 1600 fixed steps. Independently compute the nonlinear reference with scaled-deviation Radau/BDF and the early E/I linearization with both modes of the full 2×2 matrix exponential.
